segments.sn22.56:1.5: Yāvakīvañcāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ime pañcupādānakkhandhe catuparivaṭṭaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
segments.sn22.56:1.6: Yato ca khvāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ime pañcupādānakkhandhe catuparivaṭṭaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevake loke … pe … sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ”.
segments.sn22.56:2.2: Rūpaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, rūpasamudayaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, rūpanirodhaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ;
segments.sn22.56:2.3: vedanaṃ … saññaṃ … saṅkhāre … viññāṇaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, viññāṇasamudayaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, viññāṇanirodhaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
segments.sn22.56:3.2: Cattāro ca mahābhūtā catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.
segments.sn22.56:3.6: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn22.56:4.1: “Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ rūpaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ rūpasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ rūpanirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā.
segments.sn22.56:4.2: Ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
segments.sn22.56:5.1: “Ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ rūpaṃ abhiññāya … pe … evaṃ rūpanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya, rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā te suvimuttā.
segments.sn22.56:5.3: Ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
segments.sn22.56:6.2: Chayime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā – cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, jivhāsamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.
segments.sn22.56:6.7: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn22.56:7.1: “Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ vedanaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ vedanāsamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ vedanānirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya vedanāya nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā.
segments.sn22.56:7.2: Ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
segments.sn22.56:8.1: “Ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ vedanaṃ abhiññāya … pe … evaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya … pe … vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
segments.sn22.56:9.2: Chayime, bhikkhave, saññākāyā – rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.
segments.sn22.56:9.7: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saññānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi … pe … vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
segments.sn22.56:10.2: Chayime, bhikkhave, cetanākāyā – rūpasañcetanā, saddasañcetanā, gandhasañcetanā, rasasañcetanā, phoṭṭhabbasañcetanā, dhammasañcetanā.
segments.sn22.56:10.7: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn22.56:11.1: “Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ saṅkhāre abhiññāya, evaṃ saṅkhārasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ saṅkhāranirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya saṅkhārānaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā.
segments.sn22.56:11.2: Ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
segments.sn22.56:12.1: “Ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ saṅkhāre abhiññāya, evaṃ saṅkhārasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ saṅkhāranirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ saṅkhāranirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya saṅkhārānaṃ nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā.
segments.sn22.56:12.3: Ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
segments.sn22.56:13.2: Chayime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā – cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.
segments.sn22.56:13.7: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo viññāṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ – sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāsamādhi.
segments.sn22.56:14.1: “Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ viññāṇaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā.
segments.sn22.56:14.2: Ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
segments.sn22.56:15.1: “Ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ viññāṇaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimuttā, te suvimuttā.
segments.sn22.56:15.3: Ye kevalino vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāyā”ti.

lines: Paṭipannāti sīlato paṭṭhāya yāva arahattamaggā paṭipannā honti.
Ettāvatā sekkhabhūmiṃ kathetvā idāni asekkhabhūmiṃ kathento ye ca kho keci, bhikkhavetiādimāha.
Vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāyāti yena te avasiṭṭhena vaṭṭena paññāpeyyuṃ, taṃ nesaṃ vaṭṭaṃ natthi paññāpanāya.
Atha vā vaṭṭanti kāraṇaṃ, paññāpanāya kāraṇaṃ natthīti.
Rūpaṃ abbhaññāsinti sakalabhūtupādārūpaṃ kucchitabhāvato tattha ca tucchavipallāsatāya “dukkhasaccan”ti abhivisiṭṭhena ñāṇena aññāsiṃ paṭivijjhiṃ.
Āhāravasena rūpakāyassa hānivuddhādīnaṃ pākaṭabhāvato visesapaccayato ca tassa “āhārasamudayā”ti vuttaṃ.
Vattamānakālappayogo hesa yathā “kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ hotī”ti.
Yena teti yena avasiṭṭhena te asekkhe paññāpentā paññāpeyyuṃ, taṃ nesaṃ vaṭṭaṃ sekkhānaṃ viya natthi paññāpanāya.
